title: Why Egypt Hid Its Greatest Kings | Royal Cache Short
topic: Companion YouTube Short for the published Royal Cache documentary: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YIS3_xrkv4I
script:
Ramesses the Great had a royal tomb. So why was his mummy found somewhere else?

Tomb robbers threatened the Valley of the Kings—even the mightiest pharaohs.

Priests rewrapped royal bodies and moved them to safety.

High above the Nile, cliffs concealed their new resting place.

Deep inside TT320, royal mummies lay together in the dark.

The secret was revealed to officials in eighteen eighty-one.

Among the dead were Ramesses the Second and Seti the First.

Who moved them—and why? Watch The Royal Cache, the full documentary, on NeoKemetAI.
